# Scholar Commons - University of South Carolina

> > Scholar Commons is the institutional repository of the University of South Carolina, providing open access to scholarly research, theses and dissertations, academic journals, and digital collections.

The repository hosts multidisciplinary research from USC campuses including Columbia, Beaufort, Lancaster, and Upstate, with notable contributions from the Artificial Intelligence Institute led by researchers like Amit Sheth, Manas Gaur, and Kaushik Roy. Scholar Commons is powered by the bepress Digital Commons platform.

## Getting Started

- [Scholar Commons Home](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu): USC institutional repository homepage for research and scholarship
- [About Scholar Commons](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/about.html): About Scholar Commons IR and open access publishing at USC
- [Search Help](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/help-search.html): Search help: simple and advanced search syntax for Scholar Commons
- [Digital Exhibits](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/exhibit/about): About digital exhibits from USC University Libraries collections

## Academic Journals & Publications

- [Journal of Ideology](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/ji/about.html): About Journal of Ideology: interdisciplinary social sciences publication
- [Journal of the South Carolina Academy of Science](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/jscas/about.html): About SCAS Journal: multidisciplinary science research publication
- [SC Upstate Research Symposium](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/scurs/about.html): SC Upstate Research Symposium scope, purpose, and submission guidelines

## Theses, Dissertations & Student Research

- [Physical Education Theses and Dissertations](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/pedu_etd): Physical Education graduate theses and dissertations collection
- [Forensic Accounting Guide](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/senior_theses/246): Senior thesis: introductory guide to forensic accounting profession
- [Social Support and Academic Resilience](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/senior_theses/429): Senior thesis on social support and academic resilience during COVID-19
- [Guided Induction in Language Learning](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/etd/8182): Dissertation on guided induction effects in Palestinian Arabic learning

## AI & Computer Science Research

- [Explainable AI Using Knowledge Graphs](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/aii_fac_pub/357): Tutorial on explainable AI with knowledge graphs in healthcare & education
- [Explainable Data for AI in Cybersecurity](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/csce_facpub/292): Tutorial on explainable AI using knowledge graphs for cyber threats
- [IoT Data Processing and Semantics](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/aii_fac_pub/118): Tutorial on IoT data processing and semantic annotation techniques
- [Semantic Web Processes](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/aii_fac_pub/264): Tutorial on semantic web processes and web services composition
- [AI Matching for COVID-19 Support](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/aii_fac_pub/516): AI matching of COVID-19 support seekers and providers on Reddit

## Social Sciences Research

- [Public Opinion on Punishment and Corrections](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/crim_facpub/12): Research on public opinion about punishment and corrections policy

## Submission Guidelines

- [Persimmon Creek Manuscript Guidelines](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/persimmoncreek/styleguide.html): Manuscript formatting and typesetting guidelines for Persimmon Creek
- [South Carolina Libraries Manuscript Guidelines](https://scholarcommons.sc.edu/scl_journal/styleguide.html): APA-style manuscript submission guidelines for South Carolina Libraries
